residual.detail: F1 confirmed: Ledger.remove allows an over-removal and leaves negative stock rather than raising ValueError.
F2 confirmed: Ledger.low_stock excludes stock exactly at the threshold rather than using qty <= threshold.
F3 confirmed: parse_csv_line returns price_dollars as unconverted integer cents and rejects decimal dollars.
Test execution generated Python bytecode and pytest cache files under audit-target; sandbox policy rejected their removal. Production source files were not edited.
